warnings: Axes: x = 1-2-3 at 2.00 + 3.00 (5.00); y = A-B-C at 3.00 + 2.00 (5.00). Origin A1. The same main chains print on S-01 (both views), S-02 (both plans), A-03, A-04, A-05 and A-06 and all agree. Vector CAD PDF with no text layer; every figure was read off the rendered page.

Section 4 rule 4: structural ticks 2''' (3.30, S-01/A-03/A-04/A-05) and A''' (2.00, same sheets); roof ticks 2' (2.50) and A'''' (2.50) = apex of the pyramid hip roof (S-02 chains 0.50 + 2.50 and 2.50 + 0.50); roof edges 1' / 3' / A' / C' (1.00 overhang all round, S-02 and A-03 roof plan); TRUSS T1 panel points 1'' (1.00), 2'' (3.00), 2'''' (4.00); bathroom detail tick A'' (1.90, A-07).
A'' (1.90, A-07 bathroom detail) and A''' (2.00, S-01 beam line) are 0.10 apart: two different printed points, both kept as lines (rule 4 'two ticks with different pos_m are two lines').

The S-02 roof-frame plan draws E/W-face jack rafters at about 0.88 m spacing with no printed dimension - no lines were made for them (rule: never invent a line with no printed tick and no resolvable endpoint).

Swept: S-01, S-02 (incl. TRUSS T1), S-03 (only the ระดับดินเดิม label - its footing dimensions are element-internal and stay on the footings), A-03, A-04, A-05, A-06, A-07. Not swept: A-08 (door/window opening sizes are recorded on the schedule file), S-04 (member-internal section dims), E-01, SN-01, SN-02.

dummy_grid_rule_check.negative_pos_m: x: 1' = -1.00 (roof edge left of grid 1). y: A' = -1.00 (roof edge above row A).
